description: This file defines the CodebaseSearchTool class, which implements a code search utility using managed indexing or fallback to external code index manager, with methods for executing searches, parsing parameters, and handling partial requests.

classes.name: CodebaseSearchTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to perform codebase searches with support for managed indexing and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into structured search parameters, normalizing paths.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the code search operation, handling user approval, indexing status, and formatting results.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial tool invocation, prompting for missing parameters.
